title: Quick pre-flight quality score: composite (0-100) + grade (A-F) + three framewor
description: Quick pre-flight quality score: composite (0-100) + grade (A-F) + three framework sub-scores (PEEM, RAGAS, G-Eval) + verdict. Run upstream of any other paid call to filter weak prompts before inference. The cheapest gate on the AI input quality problem.

_signals.x_guidance: POST a prompt to /api/score/free for a free basic score, /api/score for a paid detailed score ($0.025 USDC), /api/score/full for optimized prompt + before/after outputs ($0.125 USDC). Anonymous x402 payment on Base mainnet is the default; bearer PQS_... API keys accepted for subscribed customers.
